title: Figure 4 — The On-Policy Distillation Loop
captions: The on-policy loop: the student generates its own data, the teacher scores it, the loss computes divergence, and the updated student generates the next batch. Training distribution always matches inference distribution.

title: Figure 1 — Mode Covering vs Mode Seeking
captions: Left: Forward KL forces the student to spread mass across all teacher modes, wasting capacity. Right: Reverse KL lets the student concentrate on the mode it can best represent and ignore the rest.

title: Figure 2 — Error Compounding: Off-Policy O(εT²) vs On-Policy O(εT)
captions: Off-policy training accumulates errors quadratically because each mistake pushes the model further out-of-distribution. On-policy training keeps errors linear by training on the model's own prefixes.

title: Figure 5 — On-Policy Self-Distillation: Two Views, Same Weights
captions: Self-distillation: both views share the same weights. The PI-conditioned view is sharper (it knows the answer), and the per-token log-ratio between views becomes the learning signal. No external teacher needed.

title: 1 The Token-Level KL Is a Fragile Proxy
subtitles: The per-token sampled KL is biased relative to the sequence-level KL the theory wants. The bias worsens with future-reward coupling, and gradient variance inflates on long trajectories.
captions: Left: the token-level KL diverges from the sequence-level target as position increases, with growing bias and variance. Right: gradient variance explodes for long sequences, destabilising training exactly where OPD is most needed.

title: 2 Prefix Drift & The Unreliable Teacher
subtitles: Once the student makes a mistake, subsequent tokens leave the teacher's support. The teacher's signal degrades from informative → noisy → harmful along the drifted prefix.
captions: The student's error at y₄ pushes the trajectory out of the teacher's support. The teacher's distribution goes from peaked and informative (left) to flat/random (right). The student earnestly distils this noise as if it were signal.

title: 3 Local Teachability Collapse
subtitles: Even when the teacher stays calibrated, its margin shrinks along the trajectory. The KL gradient carries less and less signal — not because it's wrong, but because it's barely informative.
captions: The teacher's margin (how much it "knows" at each position) decays along the trajectory. Past the change-point, the gradient carries almost no information but still contributes compute cost and noise.

title: 4 Rock Tokens & Imbalanced Supervision
subtitles: ~18% of tokens exhibit persistently high loss that never decreases, absorbing disproportionate gradient bandwidth. Meanwhile most tokens contribute near-zero gradient.
captions: Left: most tokens cluster near zero loss, but a persistent ~18% "rock token" tail absorbs disproportionate gradient norm. Right: rock-token loss never decreases over training — the student cannot and should not learn them, yet they consume ~40% of optimisation bandwidth.

title: 5 Diversity Collapse: The Precision–Recall Trade-off
subtitles: Aggressive reverse-KL OPD concentrates mass on one strategy per prompt. Pass@1 goes up, Pass@k goes down. The student loses the ability to explore alternative solutions.
captions: Reverse-KL OPD seeks the best single mode and ignores the rest. Greedy decoding improves (Pass@1 ↑), but sampling diversity collapses (Pass@k ↓). The student loses the ability to find alternative solutions when the primary one fails.

title: 6 The Privileged Information Gap & Calibration
subtitles: The PI-conditioned teacher's confidence is computed under information the deployed student cannot see. Distilling that confidence produces a miscalibrated student that is overconfident on hard problems.
captions: The teacher's confidence P(correct|x, PI) is not a valid target for the student's deployment confidence P(correct|x). The student inherits overconfidence, worst on the hardest problems where PI provides the biggest lift. Hedging language gets compressed away, amplifying the effect.

title: 8 Teacher Capability Is Doing More Work Than Admitted
subtitles: Every method assumes the teacher (given PI) is meaningfully better. When the gap is small, dense supervision becomes dense noise. The pipeline degenerates quietly.
captions: Left: when the teacher has a clear advantage from PI, distillation gives strong signal. Right: when the gap is marginal, the same dense supervision becomes dense noise. The pipeline works best with shared-rule PI and degrades with instance-specific PI on tasks where the teacher is also weak.
